note: No statutory advocate-fee schedule exists in India; fees are negotiated. The app does not invent a market rate. It uses the DSLSA panel rate as a sourced default anchor and lets the user replace it with their own quote. If the user qualifies for legal aid, the advocate line is set to zero because the legal services institution bears the panel lawyer's fee.

legalAidFloor.source: Delhi State Legal Services Authority fee schedule (2025), minimum fee ₹6,000; advocate/counsellor ₹9,000 per day or court appearance. https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s395b7a6d9a47c56ff9118bb45379fc884/uploads/2025/08/202508011960783529.pdf, accessed 2026-11-06.

panelRateNote: The ₹9,000 figure is the Delhi legal-aid panel rate, not a market rate. District-court quotes vary widely by lawyer, city and case. Enter the quote you actually have.

legalAidCover.source: NALSA, Legal Aid FAQ: expenses such as process fees, drafting fees, typing fees, clerkage and the fees of panel lawyers are borne by the legal services institutions. https://nalsa.gov.in/legal-aid/, accessed 2026-11-06.
